_comment: Copy to ~/.herdr/kit.json (install.sh does this and asks for each value). Every {{KEY}} in the kit's .tmpl files is the upper-cased key here. Values must not contain double quotes or newlines.
_owner: Your first name. Agents see it in freeze, restart and revive notices.
_org_domain: Peers add-on only: tailnet logins must end with this to connect to your core.
_services: Plain programs `hc revive` should bring back after a Herdr restart, by hc terminal name: {"poller": "python3 poll.py"}.
_peers: Set by install.sh --with-peers. Enables hc social/inbox/peer/intake/share over Tailscale.
